discrepancies.claim: “41 of 71 pending items are older than 31 days” dated to the 30 Sep checkpoint
discrepancies.finding: 41 of 71 is the 20 Oct snapshot. On 29 Sep the series is 32.
discrepancies.resolution: DX1 shell insights are superseded by the DX6 canonical insights; the DX1 board now shows INS-107 values with their dates.

discrepancies.claim: “rose from 22% to 58% between the 31 Jul and 30 Sep checkpoints” (a share)
discrepancies.finding: DX6 uses a count (22 on 1 Sep). 22% and 22 are different measures on different dates; the earlier share has no source.
discrepancies.resolution: Insights report the count; the share is reported only at the checkpoint where both parts exist (57.7% on 20 Oct).

discrepancies.finding: Recomputed median share of pending approvals waiting 31+ days across Central malls: 45.0%. 6 malls have fewer than 10 pending items (Mirage Commons: 1 of 1 = 100%).
discrepancies.resolution: Statement withdrawn. Shares need a minimum denominator of 10 (detector configuration).

discrepancies.claim: “older than 31 days” and “approvals over a month”
discrepancies.finding: V2 band is ≥ 31 days (“1 month plus delay”); “older than 31 days” would mean ≥ 32.
discrepancies.resolution: Canonical label: “waiting 31+ days (1m+)”. Contracts and leases count from their last change, proposals from creation.

discrepancies.finding: No SLA exists in the dataset; DX2 caveat: age bands are not SLA breaches. Canonical Rawdah renewals in 4 wk+: 9.
discrepancies.resolution: “Overdue” is banned in generated text (verifier word list). I3 stays a rejection test; its number is deliberately ungrounded and labelled so.

discrepancies.finding: V2 computes approvals live against NOW(); there is no history in REF. A history is a new as-of metric.
discrepancies.resolution: New metrics approvals.pending_by_delay.asof v1 and amendments.pending_by_age_band.asof v1 (kind: new), computed from seeded status history. At the as-of date they must equal the parity metrics (GI-01).

discrepancies.finding: Contracts and leases age from pms_last_modified_at: any change resets the age.
discrepancies.resolution: Insight definitions and limitations say so; cohorts in the seed do not modify 1m+ contracts unless a scenario requires it.

discrepancies.claim: Generated by D2 with a level threshold of 8 after three increases; resolved “5 on 22 Sep”
discrepancies.finding: D2 needs ≥ 4 increases in 6 changes and a net change ≥ 5. The series is 7 on 22 Sep (5 is 29 Sep).
discrepancies.resolution: Regenerated by the replay: fires on 1 Sep (3 → 9 since 21 Jul), clears on 22 Sep (8, then 7).

discrepancies.finding: Replaying the declared history, D1 already holds on 15 Sep (27 of 53, 50.9%).
discrepancies.resolution: Regenerated: INS-101 opens on 1 Sep (D2), D1 joins on 15 Sep, merged into INS-107 on 20 Oct.

discrepancies.finding: Replay: D3 holds on 6 Oct (4 against a window maximum of 9).
discrepancies.resolution: Regenerated: generated 6 Oct, updated silently on 13 and 20 Oct.

discrepancies.finding: The visible DX4 records fix the ages of the pending renewals; the series needs 6 renewals that were 4 wk+ and were resolved in the window (2026-07-31 to 2026-10-16).
discrepancies.resolution: Recorded as a required seed cohort (golden scenario manifest). Without it D6 cannot fire.

discrepancies.claim: “No prior-year data”; “Sales for 2025 are not in the dataset”
discrepancies.finding: DX2 tenant board and DR-004 include 2024–2025. September is +7.5% against September 2025; June→September fell 17.9% in 2025 and 17.9% in 2026.
discrepancies.resolution: D7 uses the prior year when ≥ 13 months exist. Result: not generated, seasonal pattern (N9). S6 expected outcome corrected — needs your confirmation.

discrepancies.claim: “2 service requests are waiting for your action” for lease T-31206
discrepancies.finding: The 2 are company-wide (Rawdah 1, Gulf Gate 1). Lease T-31206 (Sandstone Galleria) has 0.
discrepancies.resolution: D8 counts lease-scoped action items: 2 fit-out drawings to upload (Lighting layout since 12 Oct; Shopfront details re-upload since 17 Oct).

discrepancies.finding: Lease end dates exist (expiring-leases KPI, DX2).
discrepancies.resolution: Hypothesis kept as a hypothesis with a checkable question: which Mirage Commons leases ended since April without renewal.

discrepancies.finding: Creation and run disagree.
discrepancies.resolution: Version 1 from run_m_2026-09-20; version 2 from run_m_2026-10-20.

discrepancies.finding: DR-004: transactional history from 2024-01-01.
discrepancies.resolution: Limitation states the detector window (7 weekly checkpoints) instead.

discrepancies.claim: Month-end checkpoints (DR-005 example) vs weekly + monthly-on-the-20th + events
discrepancies.finding: Different calendars.
discrepancies.resolution: DXQ-12 A: weekly Tuesday checkpoints, monthly on the as-of day for stock metrics, calendar months for monthly reports, plus data-load and status-change events. DR-005 note updated.

discrepancies.finding: Two different purposes.
discrepancies.resolution: Config keys coverage.alert_below = 0.90 and coverage.min_for_regional_eval = 0.80.

discrepancies.claim: “double the trailing average; robust z ≥ 3” (and/or unclear)
discrepancies.finding: Two tests with different meanings.
discrepancies.resolution: D4a temporal and D4b cross-sectional, each stated in the evidence.

discrepancies.finding: Renewals had a flat week (7 → 7); strict D2 would not fire.
discrepancies.resolution: Formal D2: ≥ 4 increases in the last 6 changes, no decrease, net change ≥ minimum.

discrepancies.claim: Records with random ages (31–140) and random mall labels
discrepancies.finding: A fixture, not the seeded population. The reconstructed cohort needs, for example, 15 Rawdah items aged ≥ 122 days.
discrepancies.resolution: Drill-down records come from the seed in M2 (DXD-49); the prototype fixture stays labelled (DXD-50).
